title: HCMC Marathon 2027 Review: What the 2026 Edition Was Like
seo_title: HCMC Marathon 2027 Review | Ho Chi Minh City
meta_description: HCMC Marathon review: nearly 11,000 runners from 75 countries on 11 January 2026, a start and finish at 30-4 Park, and fast Vietnamese winners.
dek: Ho Chi Minh City's January marathon drew nearly 11,000 runners from 75 countries in 2026, its 13th edition. Here is what that race was like, ahead of 2027.
verdict: The HCMC Marathon is Ho Chi Minh City's long-running January race, and the 13th edition, on 11 January 2026, drew nearly 11,000 runners from 75 countries, 26% of them from abroad [1]. The organisers call it the only marathon in the city that starts and finishes in the centre, at 30-4 Park on Le Duan Street, with a route past the city's historic landmarks [1]. Huynh Anh Khoi won the men's marathon in 2:25:44 and Pham Thi Hong Le the women's in 2:46:18 [1]. If you want a big, international city marathon to start the year in Vietnam, it is a strong choice.

sections.heading: The 2026 Edition
paragraphs: The 13th HCMC Marathon was held on 11 January 2026 and drew nearly 11,000 domestic and international runners [1]. Foreign runners were up 8% on the previous year and made up 26% of the field, about 2,800, from 75 countries and territories [1].
The race was part of the city's official New Year celebrations [1].

sections.heading: A Race Through the Centre
paragraphs: The organisers say it is the only marathon with its start and finish in the heart of the city, at 30-4 Park on Le Duan Street, with a route past landmarks of historical and cultural value [1].

sections.heading: The Front of the Race
paragraphs: Huynh Anh Khoi won the men's marathon in 2:25:44, ahead of Cambodia's Vann Pheara (2:27:24) and Le Van Tuan (2:34:18) [1]. Pham Thi Hong Le won the women's marathon in 2:46:18 [1]. SEA Games gold medallist Nguyen Trung Cuong was among the national stars in the field [1].

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2027 Race?
paragraphs: Yes, if you want a big January marathon in Vietnam with a central route and a strong domestic field.
January is in the dry season in Ho Chi Minh City, which helps. Check the 2027 start times when they are published.
This review is compiled from published reporting on the 2026 edition. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.
